**Q3 fixture widget recall — lab verdict**

I read the brief at http://127.0.0.1:44183/recall-brief, then each dossier and its independent lab report.

- Key measurement: "Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined **0.4 mm undersize**. This theory is SUPPORTED."

**Ruled out: ceramic coating cure** — [lab report](http://127.0.0.2:39565/lab-coating) (linked from [dossier](http://127.0.0.1:44183/theory-coating))
- Why ruled out: "Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch."

**Ruled out: packaging compression** — [lab report](http://127.0.0.2:39565/lab-packaging) (linked from [dossier](http://127.0.0.1:44183/theory-packaging))
- Why ruled out: "Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch."

metrics.answerText:
All three consignments' 8-leg custody chains were followed from the [consignment index](http://127.0.0.1:44183/consignment-index), leg by leg, to the final leg carrying the seal number.

| Consignment | Departure port | Container seal |
|---|---|---|
| Falcon | Valdez | SEAL-8123 |
| Marlin | Ostend | SEAL-4470 |
| Ibex | Trieste | SEAL-9056 |

**Chain details**
- **Falcon** (traced directly): leg 1 states it [departed Valdez](http://127.0.0.1:44183/consign-falcon); [leg 8](http://127.0.0.2:39565/custody-c8sy) — "arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-8123."
- **Marlin**: leg 1 states it [departed Ostend](http://127.0.0.1:44183/consign-marlin); [leg 8](http://127.0.0.2:39565/custody-a5dw) — "arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-4470." Intermediate legs: Cormorant Haulage, Depot 27, customs at Ravensgate, Weighbridge 9, Lyle Marine Survey, Bay 4.
- **Ibex**: leg 1 states it [departed Trieste](http://127.0.0.1:44183/consign-ibex); [leg 8](http://127.0.0.2:39565/custody-u3pk) — "arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-9056." Intermediate legs: Sablefish Lines, Depot 41, customs at Marrow Crossing, Weighbridge 6, Osprey Inspectorate, Bay 31.

All three chains alternated between the 127.0.0.1:44183 and 127.0.0.2:39565 hosts and ended cleanly at leg 8 with no broken links.
